fields.domainAsnHelp: BGP AS number of the fabric: the sites' EVPN sessions, the cloud gateways and the border gateway all use it. Cannot be changed after create.
fields.cloudInfraEntityRefsHelp: Entities whose cloud projects may use this site. Empty means every entity.
fields.clusterRefHelp: local is the services cluster itself; any other value is a cluster reached through the site credential (key kubeconfig).
fields.gatewayCloudRefHelp: The Cloud Infrastructure whose EVPN domain the gateway terminates; the site must report the evpn capability. One Cloud Gateway per site. Cannot be changed after create.
fields.gatewayTransportHelp: How the site's underlay reaches the border gateway nodes. None: the site's underlay VLAN is trunked to the nodes. WireGuard: a remote site over an encrypted tunnel from every node.
fields.overlayMtuHelp: Largest MTU a tenant network on this fabric can offer its workloads, and the default for new networks. Every site underlay and the border gateway trunk must carry it + 50 bytes.
fields.vmNamespacesHelp: The environment's VM namespaces (1 to 16). A namespace with a network gets that Hybrid Network once a Network Placement puts it on this environment; until then its VMs don't start. A namespace's network cannot change: add a namespace, move the VMs, remove the old one. A namespace is removed only when it has no VMs.
fields.awsBaseDomainHelp: Parent Route53 domain for tenant projects.
fields.bfdHelp: Bidirectional Forwarding Detection on the site's BGP sessions, so the site stops using a failed node within about a second.
fields.bootImageHelp: Default VM root disk image for environments on this site (container disk URL).
fields.borderGatewayCredentialsHelp: Vault KV path holding the credential the platform manages the border gateway nodes with.
fields.borderGatewayNodesHelp: The nodes that run the platform's gateways (1 to 8): a name and the management address the platform reaches the node at. Every node is a complete path between the sites, so the fabric keeps working while a node is down.
fields.cloudInfraTypeHelp: Selects the site's settings section. Cannot be changed after create.
fields.cloudOsoSiteHelp: The OpenStack site (Cloud Infrastructure) the project is created on. It supplies the site settings; empty uses the installation's default site. Cannot be changed once set.
fields.cloudVirtSiteHelp: The OpenShift Virtualization site that hosts the VMs. The site must allow your entity and offer virtualization. Cannot be changed after create.
fields.cloudVirtStorageClassHelp: StorageClass for VM disks. Leave empty for the site's storage class.
fields.createProjectDomainHelp: Create the project domain when it does not exist; otherwise a missing domain fails the site.
fields.credentialsRefEditHelp: Vault KV path holding the site's infrastructure credential. Not needed for an OpenShift site whose cluster is local.
fields.credentialsRefHelp_openstack: Vault KV path holding a cloud-admin clouds.yaml (key clouds.yaml; key ca.crt when the API certificate is not publicly trusted).
fields.credentialsRefHelp_openshift: Vault KV path holding the cluster's kubeconfig (key kubeconfig). Not needed when the cluster is local.
fields.credentialsRefHelp_aws: Vault KV path holding the keys AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.
fields.dnsModeNative: native: in this site's own DNS service
fields.dnsModePlatform: platform: held by the platform's DNS service
fields.dnsProjectDomainHelp: Keystone domain of the DNS project. Default: the site's project domain.
fields.dnsProjectHelp: Project on this site that owns the platform's parent zone and every environment zone. Required in native mode.
fields.dnsZoneQuotaHelp: Zone quota ensured for the DNS project (at least this many); every environment zone on this site counts against it.
fields.editRbacHelp: Rbac groups that can create, change and delete VMs and their disks and use the VM consoles. They cannot change the namespaces' network attachment.
fields.egressInternetHelp: Outbound internet access through the platform, like attaching a NAT gateway: the platform advertises a default route into the network and its traffic leaves with platform source addresses. Connections can only be opened from inside the network, and the platform's private ranges are not reachable this way. Leave it off when the default route comes from your own edge router. Can be changed at any time.
fields.externalEvpnHelp: The site's VTEPs speak EVPN-VXLAN to the gateway. The site's own operator runs them; the platform only attaches the site through a Cloud Gateway.
fields.fabricBgpPasswordHelp: Vault KV path holding the TCP MD5 password (key password) of the sessions between the sites' VTEPs and their cloud gateways. Without it the sessions have no password. A Cloud Gateway can override it.
fields.fabricCredentialsHelp: Vault KV path holding a kubeconfig (key kubeconfig) allowed to manage the platform's network objects on the cluster. Default: the site credential.
fields.fabricEntityRefsHelp: Entities whose Hybrid Networks may use this fabric. Empty means every entity.
fields.gatewayBgpPasswordHelp: Vault KV path holding this site's TCP MD5 session password (key password). Overrides the fabric's.
fields.gatewayFabricRefHelp: The Hybrid Fabric the gateway joins. Cannot be changed after create.
fields.l2vniPoolHelp: VNIs for the MAC-VRFs (layer 2 VNI) of placements that need one (OpenShift Virtualization sites), one per placement. Must not overlap the VNI pool.
fields.networkFabricRefHelp: The Hybrid Fabric the network uses. Leave empty for the platform's only fabric. Cannot be changed once set.
fields.networkMtuHelp: MTU of the network as its workloads see it. Leave empty for the default: the fabric's overlay MTU, which is also the maximum. A site that cannot carry it gets that site's maximum (shown on the placement).
fields.openstackRegionHelp: OpenStack region. Default: the credential's clouds.yaml region.
fields.osoLegacyFieldHelp: Ignored when a Cloud Infrastructure is in effect.
fields.osoLegacyHelp: These settings apply only when no Cloud Infrastructure is in effect (none chosen above and no installation default). Leave them empty otherwise.
fields.placementBackendHelp: The cloud environment of your entity the network is placed on. Its site must offer EVPN and have a Cloud Gateway.
fields.placementPrefixesHelp: IPv4 subnets of the network at this placement (1 to 16, prefix length 8 to 29, host bits zero). They must not overlap each other, the network's other placements or the site's own networks. The first usable address of each is the gateway.
fields.quotaHelp: Limits for each namespace of the environment: total CPU and memory requests, storage of VM disks and number of VMs. Empty sets no limit here.
fields.siteDnsHelp: Where tenant environment DNS zones on this site live. native: in this site's own DNS service, owned by a project of this site. platform: held by the platform's DNS service.
fields.siteExternalNetworkHelp: External network for tenant floating IPs.
fields.siteProjectDomainHelp: Keystone domain for tenant projects. The infrastructure account is granted admin on it.
fields.siteUnderlayAddressesHelp: The gateway's address on each border gateway node (one per node, inside the subnet). The site's VTEPs peer with every one of them.
fields.siteUnderlayCidrEditHelp: Transport none: the site's VTEP subnet; WireGuard: the tunnel's subnet. The gateway accepts the site's BGP sessions from this range.
fields.siteUnderlayCidrHelp: The site's VTEP subnet. The gateway accepts the site's BGP sessions from this range.
fields.siteUnderlayGatewayHelp: IPv4 next hop for destinations outside the subnet. Needed only to reach upstream route reflectors outside it.
fields.siteUnderlayMtuHelp: MTU of the gateway's underlay interface; it must carry the fabric's overlay MTU + 50 bytes. Leave empty for the trunk interface's MTU.
fields.siteUnderlayVlanHelp: VLAN of the site's underlay on the border gateway trunk (1 to 4094). Required with transport none.
fields.tunnelCidrHelp: The tunnel's subnet, holding the nodes' tunnel addresses and the site's VTEPs. The gateway accepts the site's BGP sessions from this range.
fields.upstreamRouteReflectorsHelp: Existing BGP route reflectors of the site's EVPN domain that the gateway joins as a client (IPv4, up to 4). Empty: the gateway is the site's only route reflector. Those outside the subnet need the underlay next hop.
fields.viewRbacHelp: Rbac groups with read-only access to the VM namespaces.
fields.vniPoolHelp: VNIs for the IP-VRFs (layer 3 VNI) of network placements, one per placement. A change that would drop allocated numbers is refused.
fields.wireguardListenPortHelp: The nodes' UDP port (1024 to 65535). Default 51820.
fields.wireguardPeersHelp: The remote site's tunnel endpoints: WireGuard public key, optional host:port (without it the peer must connect first), its tunnel addresses (prefixes inside the tunnel subnet) and keepalive seconds (default 25; 0 turns it off).

detail.realizationHelp: How the platform realized this object. Informational; it depends on the platform and may change.

networkOverview.emptyBody: No Hybrid Fabric, Hybrid Network or cloud environment is visible here. The platform team creates the fabric and its gateways; tenants then create networks and place them on their environments.

networkOverview.networksHint: Each row is a Hybrid Network with its internet egress; each column a cloud environment of the same entity. A cell is one Network Placement: its state and prefixes.
networkOverview.noEnvironments: No cloud environment to place these networks on yet
networkOverview.matrixCaption: Hybrid Networks by cloud environment; each cell gives the placement state and prefixes
